SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.type AS type, s.name AS name, ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, s.park_warning AS park_warning, d.operating_status AS operating_status, d.closed_from AS closed_from, d.closed_until AS closed_until FROM spot s LEFT JOIN public_spot_detail d ON d.spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN bakji_detail b ON b.spot_id = s.id
ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT AVG(c.lat) AS lat, AVG(c.lng) AS lng, COUNT(*) AS spot_count FROM ( SELECT ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, LEAST(FLOOR((ST_Latitude(s.location) - #{area.swLat}) / #{grid.cellLat}), #{grid.lastCellIndex}) AS cell_row, LEAST(FLOOR((ST_Longitude(s.location) - #{area.swLng}) / #{grid.cellLng}), #{grid.lastCellIndex}) AS cell_column FROM spot s LEFT JOIN bakji_detail b ON b.spot_id = s.id
) c GROUP BY c.cell_row, c.cell_column ORDER BY c.cell_row, c.cell_column
